items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 12:1
items.html: Because she is a phase of Atzilut, whose root is from a screen of phase three, and a screen of phase two does not govern her. Therefore she “pierces and breaks” it — meaning that with respect to her this screen is regarded not as blocked, as above in Item 112, but as open. And although she descends beneath it, she is not bounded thereby, but is always able to return to Atzilut. (Chapter 7, Item 1, and Inner Light, Item 3)
